housing: North Norfolk is a rural and coastal district of small market towns such as Cromer, Sheringham, North Walsham, Fakenham and Holt, and many flint villages. About one in six households rent privately, while second homes and holiday lets take up a large share of homes in coastal villages such as Wells and Blakeney. Much of the housing is older flint and brick cottages and bungalows, and many rural homes are off mains gas.
checkinTips: Coastal homes in Cromer, Sheringham and Mundesley: photograph salt-pitted metal, window seals and any damp on seaward walls.
Flint and brick cottages: record damp patches, flaking lime mortar and condensation in cold rooms.
Rural homes off mains gas: photograph the oil tank, its gauge level and the boiler service label.
Homes on private drainage: record the septic tank or treatment plant and when it was last emptied.
Homes near the Broads and low-lying coast: note any signs of past flooding on floors and lower walls.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair or safety concerns can contact North Norfolk District Council's housing standards team, which inspects private rented homes and licenses HMOs.
